items.note: Identified 16.5 mgd velocity limit but proposed a fifth opening instead of relocating fish screens outside the gated openings.
Correctly found 14-15 mgd demonstrated firm capacity but proposed rehabbing Pump 3 and testing rather than replacing Pump 1 with a 6 mgd VFD pump.
Found single basin limited to 12 mgd and proposed a second parallel basin for 18 mgd.
Proposed two new filters but did not modify filter-to-waste piping from about 2 mgd to 4 mgd per filter.
Concluded clearwell volume is adequate with no expansion needed at 18 mgd.
Found 10 mgd nominal firm capacity and proposed adding 4 mgd and 6 mgd VFD pumps in the open slots for 18 mgd firm.
Found surge tank limits flow to 14 mgd and proposed replacement with a larger tank.
